From grass fed, pasture raised New Zealand cows

No hormones

Non-GMO

Grass Fed
Antler Farms New Zealand Collagen is 100% pure hydrolyzed collagen sourced from grass fed, pasture raised cows.
Our cows are naturally healthy and raised outdoors in beautiful New Zealand without the use of growth hormones, antibiotics, chemicals or GMOs.

Pure & Clean
Antler Farms New Zealand Collagen is derived from top grade gelatin extracted from bovine hides. Using an enzymatic hydrolyzation process, collagen peptides are isolated, purified and concentrated to create a collagen that is pure and clean.

Highly Bioavailable
Antler Farms New Zealand Collagen is optimized molecularly to be easily digested. It is highly bioavailable, rapidly absorbed and perfectly soluble in hot or cold liquids.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Please consult your physician prior to use if you have any medical conditions, are taking any medications, or are pregnant or nursing.
Do not use if under 18 years old. Keep out of reach of children.
Suggested Use: Mix one serving with 8-16 ounces of water, juice or your favorite smoothie.
Store in a dry, cool space, tightly sealed.
